description: YuniLlama is a comprehensive Large Language Model (LLM) integration plugin for Unreal Engine, developed by YuniTech. It provides a robust, production-ready solution for incorporating AI-powered conversational capabilities into Unreal Engine projects, with support for tool calling, multi-player contexts, and extensive customization options.

items.title: Key Features
items: GGUF model support with GPU layer offloading
Streaming token generation and configurable sampling parameters
Multi-player conversation histories with context isolation
Tool calling system with JSON schema validation and asynchronous execution
System prompt management with modular prompt composition
Blueprint integration with full UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION exposure
Editor integration including built-in chat interface for testing
Thread-safe model loading and inference with background worker threads
Memory management with RAII patterns and automatic resource cleanup
Cross-platform support (Windows, Mac, Linux) with CUDA/Metal/Vulkan acceleration
Production-ready plugin with comprehensive API documentation
Extensive customization options for model parameters and inference settings

description: YuniLlama's architecture is built around several core modules that provide comprehensive LLM functionality to Unreal Engine projects.
- YuniLlama Module: Main runtime module providing LLM functionality
- Editor Module: Provides editor integration and chat interface
- Third-Party Integration: Contains llama.cpp library and GGML backend
- Data Structures: Core data types for model configurations, messages, and parameters
- Tool Calling System: Sophisticated tool calling with IToolProvider interface
- System Prompt Management: Flexible prompt composition system
- JSON Utilities: Blueprintable JSON object wrappers
- UYuniLlamaGameSubsystem: Game instance subsystem for model management
- UYuniLlamaLinkComponent: Actor component for linking AI roles to players
- FYuniLlamaSubsystemBase: Base implementation for shared functionality
- FYuniLlamaNative: Native wrapper for llama.cpp operations
